# CVT — File Format Converter

A universal converter for AI agents and humans.

## Features

- Convert between dozens of formats
- Batch conversion support
- Modular backend system

## Usage

```bash
cvt convert input.md output.pdf
cvt batch --from csv --to json --dir ./data
```

## Supported Formats

| Category | Formats |
|----------|---------|
| Data     | JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV, TSV, INI |
| Markup   | Markdown, HTML, TXT |
| Office   | DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF |
| Image    | PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, GIF, TIFF |
